description: Configurable weights for AIStackRecommendationEngine. Edit values here to tune recommendation behavior without code changes.

compositeScore._comment: Weights for per-provider composite score. Must sum to 1.0.

preferenceModifiers._comment: Score adjustments applied based on user preference toggles.

maximizeSavings._comment: When active, rebalances weights: costEfficiency += 0.15, capabilityScore -= 0.10

confidenceWeights._comment: Weights for 7-factor confidence score per recommendation. Must sum to 1.0.

stackGeneration._comment: Parameters controlling the GreedyCoverStrategy stack generation.

knowledgeScoring._comment: Weights used by KnowledgeScoringEngine to compute normalized dimension scores.

costTiers._comment: costEfficiencyScore based on cheapest monthly plan price per seat.
